title: HCP — Directive
description: The Human Context Protocol (HCP) 2.0-draft-3 directive (HCP 6.4), shared by the hcp/* tasks. Written for this registry from the HCP 2.0-draft-3 specification text (CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/loyalagents/hcp-spec), with attribution; not copied from HCP's own schema files. Open, as HCP's objects are (HCP Appendix A.3). Where this schema and the HCP text differ, the HCP text governs.

Directive.description: A directive the person set on what a client may do with disclosed context (HCP 6.4). A directive only narrows what a grant allows, and the provider delivers every applicable directive with every read result. Members other than the action and effect are carried as HCP defines them.

action.description: The action the directive governs: `share`, `sign` or `transact`, or an absolute URI naming another action.

effect.description: What the directive says about the action: `deny`, `ask-first` or `permit`. HCP's own values, carried verbatim. A `permit` never widens the grant.
